notes: Current hinged trifold introduces a partnership that starts with new business and can grow with Handrail. Compensation and proposed status remain clear; actual company branding is retained.

Three hinged HTML panels open from a folded cover, then present stable reading holds, chapter navigation, ordinary reading and direct proposal notes/PDF. Mobile separates long cash-flow content, individual rate paths and the rationale.
Rendered brand treatment uses official logo, warm paper/rust and Inter/Playfair. Global design-token certification has not been established for this redesign.
Three current DealPath checks passed with zero axe violations and zero uncaught errors. Hinges and camera are document-level behavior verified by browser tests, not obsolete React/WebGL stories.
19 browser tests include two passing route-level axe scans and keyboard/reduced-motion paths. Manual VoiceOver and physical-device review remain unverified.

19 browser checks passed. All 24 chapter views and 15 actual-scroll samples were captured; implementation and browser reviewers inspected desktop/mobile states. Both wings visibly move and reverse; reading faces are flat, framed and at least 14.05px in the recorded text samples.

The beginning-of-partnership copy leaves room for Brent's contribution to evolve without inventing future roles. It retains customer collections before commission, benefits as a separate cost and Handrail preparing the final contract.

Current trifold local Lighthouse: 100 in all four categories on both devices. Mobile LCP 1656.355ms / TBT 0ms / CLS 0.02279675; desktop LCP 368.8312ms / TBT 0ms / CLS 0.01910344. Field INP and physical-device measurements remain unavailable; no earlier keyboard-cleanup caveat applies to this run.
Measured route script transfer is 46,763 bytes (120,036 resource bytes).
Native controls and semantic HTML provide both animated and ordinary reading paths without a canvas.

Current local check: 22 files, zero issues. Four unit, 19 browser and three component checks passed. Captures contain 24 chapter views and 15 scroll samples, with zero browser errors, warnings or failed requests. The same 19 browser checks passed hosted; full global certification remains unclaimed.

The revised document has real left/right hinges instead of a rigid flat camera plane. Numeric-camera uniform scale3d fixes exaggerated hinge depth and header clipping. Mobile cash content is split into readable targets; current checks cover keyboard focus, Back restoration and native touch gestures.
No API, database or authentication. Local presentation-preference storage is the only retained UI state.

coveredDataStates: Static proposal content; folded and unfolding trifold, flat reading holds, ordinary reading, system reduced motion and JavaScript-disabled flow.
mutationSafety: No business mutations; isolated browser preference storage only.

scope: User-approved local trifold redesign; reference approval does not establish final visual acceptance or full global lifecycle certification.
